chunks.heading: projects
chunks.text: ## Psychiatric readmission risk prediction My psychiatric readmission research uses structured EHR data and clinical notes from MIMIC-IV. The pipeline covered 238,491 admissions from 107,926 patients, with patient-level data partitioning. Models compared included LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost, Random Forest, neural networks, LSTM/GRU and ensembles. The final ensemble achieved ROC-AUC 0.8014 and PR-AUC 0.5965, as reported in my CV. Evaluation included SHAP, calibration, subgroup analysis, feature reduction and leakage auditing. These are research results, not evidence of deployment in clinical ca
